verdict.rationale: Warp's own API docs describe endpoints to create and send candidate offers and manage their lifecycle, so the offer-letter part of the story is documented. Nothing in the evidence mentions e-signature, sending other HR documents, or storing signed documents per employee. Mentions of contractor contracts and agent-handled onboarding are adjacent claims and earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented e-signature capability, sending of general HR documents, per-employee document storage, independent or hands-on corroboration.
